messages.name: doc.fetch
messages.content:
Policy Memo: Use of Agency Resources

Section 1: Purpose
This memorandum clarifies permissible uses of agency equipment.

Section 2: Guidance
The Judge may require the staff member to submit a rationale for employing the office copier prior to any ruling. According to §2635.704, using the agency photocopier for personal fundraising would violate the standards on use of Government property. Fundraising is defined as raising money for a nonprofit organization, other than a political organization, through solicitation of funds or sale of items, or participation in an event where costs are tax deductible. Employees may engage in fundraising in a personal capacity only if they do not personally solicit subordinates or prohibited sources and do not use official title, position, or authority.

Additional considerations:
The department may consider allocating dedicated copy time for official publications. The office could issue a temporary waiver for emergency printing needs.

Section 3: Enforcement
Violations may result in administrative action. For further clarification, contact the Office of General Counsel.

--- End of Memo ---
